description: This PHP source file handles AJAX requests related to WPS (Wi-Fi Protected Setup) configuration, including enabling/disabling WPS, setting WPS methods, pairing clients via push button or PIN, and canceling sessions. It performs reading of POST data, validation of PINs, and communicates with device configuration settings.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates the checksum of a WPS PIN to ensure its correctness.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Applies settings to a specific SSID based on its number.
